Rhea N: quick RFC follow-up — we still need to pick a firm model: "intent-only" vs "authoritative intent". i.e., do apps submit a desired pct and platform finalizes, or do apps get a binding spec?

Caleb M: my vote: apps submit intent. platform synthesizes a concrete plan and publishes decisions hosts must obey. keeps global safety.

Jun W: +1 for intent, but hosts need a predictable accept rule. propose sequenced decisions with lease window. host accepts if seq>last_seq && now < effective_until.

Ivy P: i'm worried about transient host failures. if a host sees p95 explode, it should be able to flip to fallback immediately. suggest local short-lived overrides (ttl 30s) that don't replace planner's plan unless aggregated.

Rhea N: agreed. two-plane model: central planner = policy, host overrides = safety fast-path. planner decides long-term routing. hosts emit tokens when they locally fallback.

Caleb M: token shape (as stringified JSON in telemetry): {host, seq_seen, reason_code, ttl_seconds}. reason_code enum: ["CPU_SPIN","OOM","NET_DEG","SLOW_MODEL"].

Jun W: planner behavior: ignore isolated tokens; if X% of hosts in cohort emit same reason within W window, escalate and either throttle canary or rollback. thresholds configurable per-service.

Ivy P: we need hysteresis so hosts don't flip-flop while planner converges. local re-enable should use exponential backoff starting at 5s up to 2m. planner-level rollbacks require N consecutive windows by default.

Rhea N: API surfaces to specify: POST /intents -> intent_id; GET /plans/{intent_id} -> plan (seq + assignments); GET /hosts/{id}/status -> assignment + active_local_tokens. ops-only POST /plans/{id}/override. all changes require client_request_id.

Caleb M: add read-only websocket /events/planner for SRE to stream plan events and aggregated local tokens. useful for on-call.

Jun W: compatibility note: older agents without seq checks should accept plan_id changes but will log a deprecation warning. include deprecation timeline in RFC.

Ivy P: audit and RBAC: intents > 20% must pass approval workflow. all plan changes stored with author, diff, client_request_id. overrides require two-person approval by default.

planner-bot: Planner published plan 2901234567 (seq=77) at 2026-03-23T17:45:00Z :white_check_mark:

Rhea N: action items: Caleb draft API schema + ws spec, Jun prototype host seq+ttl shim, Ivy draft runbook for local tokens & backoff, i'll update RFC and add RBAC tickets. reconvene after PRs land. thanks.
